userInstruction: Try the user-provided zayuapi test-only credential at its normalized legacy API base endpoint; failed requests do not consume successful capability quotas.
requiredBehavior: Read the single test-only credential only inside the private runner and never print or persist its value outside the private form.
Call only the exact normalized image-generation endpoint bound by the endpoint fingerprint; do not probe models, edits, responses or sibling endpoints.
Run text generation first with no automatic retry. Stop immediately without starting another matrix case if it produces no accepted image.
Only after text generation succeeds, run the remaining approved synthetic matrix in order within the raw-request and cost-risk ceilings.
Count only successful accepted outputs toward per-class success quotas; count every raw request in mayHaveBilled and the USD 10 cost-risk ceiling.
Allow at most ten minutes per case and never replay partial batch work or any request that produced output.
Keep the credential, full URL, authorization header, raw responses and image bytes outside the repository.
